title: Five things currently broken/unfinished in Varve

limitations.title: Flatpak is not shippable yet
reproductionSteps: Inspect the current Flatpak manifest readiness entry.
Run the documented flatpak-builder command only after a human completes the missing offline sources.

limitations.title: The separate web app is still a scaffold
reproductionSteps: The shippable editor remains apps/desktop’s browser demo rather than this package.

limitations.title: Linux WebKitGTK uses Canvas2D, not WebGPU
reproductionSteps: Launch the native Linux build with the capture diagnostics enabled.
Read the real backend/capability status; do not infer it from Chromium.

limitations.title: PDF export has no Canvas2D visual-parity golden

anchors: No visual-parity test between the native PDF export path

reproductionSteps: Compare it against the same on-screen document; the repository has unit tests, not a PDF-vs-canvas pixel golden.

limitations.title: Motion video export is provider-gated
reproductionSteps: Open Motion Export in a runtime without WebCodecs.
Use the available CSS/Lottie paths or Chromium for video; the UI reports the provider limitation.
